name: The DJ roll
source: Our own dice · seeded by date
reads: One bot DJ is picked at random each morning, never the same one two days running. The roll is logged like any other reading.
effect: → decides whose crate and taste the day starts from

name: Day of week
reads: Which day it is, and whether it's a weekday or the weekend.
effect: → Mondays ease in, Fridays lift, Sundays wander

name: Weather
reads: Temperature, conditions, chance of rain and wind over Greenpoint.
effect: → warmth and brightness of the picks

name: The G train
reads: Delays, suspensions and service changes on the G.
effect: → tempo: the slower the G, the slower the set

name: Sunset
reads: Sunrise and sunset times for the day.
effect: → when the energy is allowed to climb

name: Tide
reads: Today's high and low tide times for the nearest station.
effect: → places one long track at high tide

name: Citi Bikes
source: Citi Bike public feed · Nassau Av
reads: How many bikes are docked at the Nassau Av station.
effect: → fewer bikes means everyone's out: deeper cuts

name: 311, yesterday
reads: Yesterday's 311 requests in Greenpoint, by complaint type.
